Description: Human-in-the-Loop review interface for an Admin Approval Application in a Student Helpdesk Automation system. Allows administrators to review AI-extracted information from student emails and make a decision.

inputs.name: StudentEmail
inputs.description: The full content of the student's email.

inputs.name: CategoryName
inputs.description: The AI-classified category of the student's email.

inputs.name: ExtractionStatus
inputs.description: The status of information extraction from the email.

inputs.name: ExtractedFields
inputs.description: List of key-value pairs of information extracted from the email.

inputs.name: CategoryExplanation
inputs.description: A brief explanation of why the email was classified into this category.

outputs.name: ReviewerComment
outputs.description: Optional feedback or notes provided by the reviewer.

outcomes.name: Approve
outcomes.description: The administrator approves the AI-extracted information and classification.

outcomes.name: Reject
outcomes.description: The administrator rejects the AI-extracted information or classification.

outcomes.name: ManualHandling
outcomes.description: The administrator decides the case requires manual intervention outside the automated workflow.

name: ActionSchema
